in_marathi.name: Devindra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Indra, Lord of Thunder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devindra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devindra is a combination of two Sanskrit words – ‘Deva’ (God) and ‘Indra’ (Lord of Thunder). In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of gods and the god of rain, storm, and lightning. This name signifies power, strength, and divine blessings.
